recent_actions.Action: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz affirmed that the Israeli army will not withdraw from South Lebanon until Hezbollah “is disarmed”, stressing that this security equation is “included in the annex of the framework agreement” signed between Beirut and Tel Aviv in Washington on Friday. Affirming that he does not believe that the Lebanese army “will suddenly become made up of lions attacking Hezbollah,” Israel Katz said that the Israeli occupation of the South will “therefore be long-term.”
